channel.title: Sergey Yurkevich's blog
channel.description: Short notes on AI models, tools and research worth knowing about.

item.title: Claude Fable produces a counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture
item.description: On July 19, 2026, Levent Alpöge announced a Claude Fable counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture: a map with constant Jacobian determinant -2 and no inverse.

item.title: Demis Hassabis proposes a FINRA-style body to regulate frontier AI
item.description: In a July 14 manifesto Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis called for a US-led, industry-funded AI standards body that could vet frontier models before release and even pause the industry.

item.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model
item.description: Kimi K3 is the largest open-weight model so far, scores near Fable 5 on the Intelligence Index, and tops the blind-voted Frontend Code arena.
